notes_for_editor: Almost all detail comes from one compiled list (the A-Z PDF). Wikidata's 1932 date and 100 ft height show no references on the page, so they do not independently confirm the A-Z list. The A-Z list credits the CCC, which ran from 1933 to 1942, so the CCC credit and the 1932 date conflict. The story says so; the sources do not resolve it. The 1936 survey note (80 ft, station about 16 miles north of Chisholm) sits in the Side Lake row of the A-Z PDF, checked against the PDF text layout, so its attribution holds. The Wikidata link to a minnesotafiretower.blogspot.com post returned 404. No access, staffing or fire information was found. The brief's record (standing, 100 ft, 1932 built) is supported, and its agency field is left general.
